theorems.name: Submission.covectorEuclideanNorm_gram_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin n → Euclid P), |α v| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)))) ∧ ∀ τ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ α τ = 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
